comparison.objective: Clamp wood and saw a retained piece to length; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Vise operation and sustained hand-saw trajectory versus fine hex-tool access, collar adjustment, relocking, and guarded impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly two wood pieces and 150 ± 1 mm retained length with the saw clear; candidate requires repeatable safe carriage stopping without bottoming or drift.
comparison.reason: The cutting and dimensional-manufacturing ability is unrelated to damper adjustment and dynamic response tuning.
